message.text:
Only s3presign is started by the server. It runs once immediately at startup, then every 12 hours via time.Ticker. Unused scheduling infrastructure was noted but not detailed.

internal/scheduler is unused. memopayload.NewRunner is never started as a background worker; RebuildMemoPayload runs inline from memo handlers. Webhook and email worker pools start on package import, not through Server.startBackgroundRunners.

message.text:
The server explicitly starts only s3presign. The internal/scheduler package contains a full cron scheduler that was never wired into the server.

server/runner/memopayload is also unused. Its RunOnce method is never called by the server. RebuildMemoPayload runs synchronously inside request handlers instead.

q28.
s3presign — `RunOnce` at startup, then `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)

`Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` is the only place that starts a runner. `internal/scheduler` (cron) is never imported or started. `server/runner/memopayload`’s `Runner.RunOnce` is also never started; only `RebuildMemoPayload` runs inline from memo handlers. Webhook/email worker pools start via package `init()` (`internal/webhook`, `internal/email`), not the server runner loop.
